reason: A fresh Chrome native trace advertises surrounding-text capability but supplies no snapshot. IBus 1.5.26 retains that capability after the widget refuses RetrieveSurrounding. Requiring a snapshot to begin literal composition therefore suppresses hints and Tab indefinitely.
decision: When precognition is enabled, after the existing authenticated Ready, a nonterminal stock legacy client without an exact-refresh contract or a surrounding snapshot may begin the existing literal owned preedit for newly consumed letters. Preserve UnknownStart and all client-text deletion, selection, sensitive-content, output and admission guards. Disabled assistance and native terminal input retain their existing contracts.
